Are things worth investing in if you are a creator that wants to take content creation seriously. One is going to be your wardrobe. You want to make sure that none of your clothing has any logos or graphics on it, especially if you're filming for brand deals. Two, is going to be a creator community. This space can get really, really lonely, and it's nice to have people to lean on, to keep your head straight, and just to keep you in the game longer. Three, is going to be a chat GPT, or a Claude Max subscription. It's going to help you a lot when it comes to ideation and research for any of the content that you're going to be creating. Four, is Stan Store, because it's amazing as a link in bio tool, but also if you decide to monetize down the line, through digital products, or communities, or courses, you can house all of that on there and so much more. Five is a good microphone, especially if you have any forced air, or AC noises, or anything in your house, condo, or apartment. It really, really blurs it out, and you don't want bad audio in any of your videos. And if you want the entire list, just check the caption. I've broken everything down for you.
